name: 大序号·静蓝
description: 大序号标注章节+清爽蓝色强调，适合结构清晰的教程、指南类文章

styles.h1: font-size: 24px; font-weight: 800; color: #1a1a1a; text-align: center; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 12px; line-height: 1.35;
styles.h2: font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: #1a1a1a; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 16px; line-height: 1.3;
styles.h3: font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; color: #1a1a1a; margin-top: 24px; margin-bottom: 10px; line-height: 1.3;
styles.h4: font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: #333; margin-top: 20px; margin-bottom: 8px; line-height: 1.3;
styles.h5: font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: #555; margin-top: 18px; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.3;
styles.h6: font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #888; margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.3;
styles.p: font-size: 16px; color: #333333; line-height: 2; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 18px; letter-spacing: 0.2px; text-align: justify;
styles.blockquote: border-left: 3px solid #2563eb; background: rgba(37,99,235,0.03); margin-top: 18px; margin-bottom: 18px; border-radius: 0 10px 10px 0; font-size: 15px; color: #1d4ed8; line-height: 1.7; font-style: italic;
styles.blockquote p: font-size: 15px; color: #1d4ed8; line-height: 1.7; margin-bottom: 0; font-style: normal; background: transparent;
styles.img: max-width: 100%; border-radius: 12px; display: block; background: #ffffff; margin-top: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px;
styles.hr: margin-top: 28px; margin-bottom: 28px; height: 1px; background: #dbeafe; border: none;
styles.code: background: rgba(37,99,235,0.08); border-radius: 5px; font-size: 90%; color: #1d4ed8; font-family: Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace;
styles.pre: background: #1e293b; border-radius: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; overflow: hidden; color: #e2e8f0; overflow-x: auto; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; white-space: pre-wrap; word-wrap: break-word; word-break: break-all;
styles.pre::before: display: flex; align-items: center; height: 36px; background: #0f172a;
styles.pre code: background: none; color: #e2e8f0; font-size: 14px; font-family: Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace;
styles.table: width: 100%; border-collapse: separate; margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 16px; font-size: 14px; border-spacing: 0; border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb;
styles.th: background: rgba(37,99,235,0.06); border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; text-align: left; font-weight: 600; color: #1d4ed8;
styles.ol li::marker: display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 22px; height: 22px; min-width: 22px; background: rgba(37,99,235,0.1); color: #2563eb; border-radius: 50%; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; margin-right: 10px; margin-top: 4px;
styles.li: font-size: 16px; color: #333; line-height: 2; letter-spacing: 0.2px; display: flex; margin-bottom: 8px; align-items: flex-start;
styles.footnotes li: font-size: 13px; color: #999; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.6; word-break: break-all;
